## Objective
- Continue and finish the existing game, making it complete and playable without asking clarifying questions.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Kept the existing game, “Ash & Oath,” and its explore → ember-wisp hunt → shrine choice → ending flow.
- Updated mouse attacks to face and target the cursor direction rather than automatically hitting any nearby enemy.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game implementation and launched it locally.
- Changed `game.js` so pointer movement sets player facing, and mouse attacks only hit enemies in a forward-facing arc.
- Verified `game.js` parses with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright, viewed JPEG screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/ash-intro.jpg`, `/tmp/opencode/ash-play.jpg`, and `/tmp/opencode/ash-interact.jpg`, and observed no browser console errors.

### Active
- Continue testing and polishing the game’s complete playthrough, including dialogue, combat, shrine interaction, and endings.

### Blocked
- An attempted combined `playwright-cli run-code` test failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier 'page'`; no successful end-to-end playthrough has been verified.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current game and git changes; confirm the local server and Playwright session are still available.
2. Test the interaction flow with separate Playwright commands or valid `run-code` syntax; determine why movement did not bring the player near Mara during the attempted test.
3. Fix any gameplay or interface issues found, then verify both shrine outcomes and report the assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, combat, world rendering, and recent mouse-aim changes.
- `index.html`: Game UI, controls, dialogue, choice, and ending overlays.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright launched at `http://localhost:3002`; browser console reported zero errors.
- The player begins at `(760,730)` and Mara is at `(490,600)`; interaction range is under 100 units.

## Objective
- Finish the existing “Ash & Oath” game so it is complete and playable without clarification.

- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Mouse attacks face and target the cursor direction rather than automatically hitting any nearby enemy.

- Updated `game.js` so pointer movement sets player facing and mouse attacks hit within a forward-facing arc.
- Confirmed `game.js` parses with `node --check`.
- Started a local server at `http://localhost:3002` and used Playwright to inspect the game; earlier checks reported no browser console errors.
